claims.statement: For an exact-rank-three O3 packet with one spectral-rank-one original-coordinate resource bank H, cross-bank aggregate principal-triple mass mu>0, and nonzero grouped scalar coefficient a, the exact scalar Schur residual on the other two banks has rank-two nonzero-eigenvalue product Pi satisfying |a| Pi >= mu. Consequently ||p_Q||_infinity <= 16 sqrt(60) mu^(-1/4)|a|^(-1/4). In particular mu>=1/512 and |a|>=1/24 imply ||p_Q||_infinity<1305.
In the same packet, if mu>=1/512 and 0<|a|<1/24, the exact rank-two physical Schur residual has product of its two nonzero absolute eigenvalues Pi>3/64.

On the exact fleet04/B20 r4 longitudinal/transverse overlap with a physical companion row of leverage at least 1/2, |v^T M v|<=1/2 is paid by the partner bound <105.463; the complement |v^T M v|>1/2 has |a|>1/4 and is paid by the new theorem when mu>=1/512.
